note: Neutral Azure Dragon (CaDrgn.DEF). Mesh: regenerated artifacts/meshy_downloads/meshy7_missing/h3_azure_dragon/mesh.glb (wings half-raised, wrist at the top), installed with install_mesh.py and scaled to a 1.7 height like the fleet dragons; its midline sits at x=-0.18 (the bbox centre is pulled by the tail). No mocap capture: body hand-keyed (hand_stub.py stand-in; handKeys from handoffs/neutral_tools/azure_dragon_hand_keys.py), wings are wing_chain finger fans (red dragon recipe) with per-clip anim and a silhouette fit of the wing params only (no whole-body offsets).

glbPatch.reason: DEF g00 move: the dragon flies low and level - body lifted off the floor and horizontal, neck stretched forward with the head level at the travel; ours crouched with the chest up and the head held high on a vertical neck. Lift the body 0.30, level the chest (Spine2), stretch the neck forward and level the head; MoveStart lifts into it, MoveEnd settles out. Idle breathes (Spine2/Neck/Head) instead of a dead hold.
